About

I'm a Senior Unity Engineer focused on mobile games. I build and ship gameplay systems, UI flows, and live-ops features with a strong bias for performance, clarity, and maintainability.

I've worked across 2D/3D, AR/VR, and production live games—owning features end-to-end from prototype to release. I collaborate closely with designers and artists, write clean C# and scalable architecture, and profile/optimize for smooth gameplay on real devices.

Strengths

  • Bridging art + tech for polished visuals
  • Performance optimization on real devices
  • Shipping features end-to-end
  • Technical leadership & mentoring
